cohort: The study included 50 appropriate for gestational age (AGA) neonates with HIE and 50 AGA normal neonates, matched for age and sex, born at Tanta University Hospital between June 2016 and March 2018.
finding: Neonates with HIE had significantly lower cord blood pH and adiponectin levels and significantly higher leptin and erythropoietin levels compared to normal neonates, with these markers also correlating with HIE severity, and erythropoietin demonstrating the best predictive performance for HIE.
mod_finding: There were no significant differences between neonates with HIE and normal neonates regarding mode of delivery.
birth_weight: Appropriate for gestational age (AGA); no significant difference in weight between HIE and normal neonates.
gest_age: Appropriate for gestational age (AGA); no significant difference in gestational age between HIE and normal neonates.
